candidate_workaround: Search the directory root and let ripgrep recurse instead of passing Windows wildcard path arguments.
failure_signature: A read-only ripgrep command passed literal Windows wildcard paths and stopped with an invalid filename or directory syntax error before reading the intended files.
recurrence_guard: On Windows, pass a real directory to ripgrep and filter results by pattern; do not assume shell wildcard expansion in path arguments.
rollback: Keep the failed wildcard probe with zero search credit and change no repository state until a directory-scoped query passes.
scope_boundary: Same-owner read-only path-query recovery only; no scientific, professional, legal, cultural, Maori-authority, production, security, accessibility, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Use directory-scoped ripgrep on Windows
trigger_preconditions: A recursive text search is needed across files on Windows PowerShell.
